tax: Taxa de stat (autentificarea contractelor de înstrăinare a bunurilor imobile)
statute: Legea taxei de stat nr. 213/2023 art. 4, anexa nr. 1 pct. 8.3.2 (0,5 % of the contract price, not less than on the registered value)
dated: Legea nr. 213/2023 as in force 01.01.2025 (edition of 26.09.2024), read on legis.md in a browser on 26 November 2026 (doc_id=145352)
unsupported: transfers to a child, spouse, parent, sibling, grandparent or grandchild pay 0,1 % (pct. 8.3.1): the relation is not in the input and 0,5 % is applied
reading taken: pct. 8.2 (5 lei) is the privatisation of public housing, not a sale between private persons
the exemptions of anexa nr. 2 and the Prima casă rate (pct. 8.4, 0,1 %) are not modelled

statute: Codul fiscal Titlul VI art. 280 alin. (1) lit. a) (residential property: at least 0,05 % of the taxable base, the rate set each year by the local council), Chișinău 2025: Dispoziția Primarului General nr. 588-d din 27.12.2024, anexa nr. 6 pct. 1 (0,185 %)
dated: Codul fiscal nr. 1163/1997 as in force 01.01.2025, read on legis.md in a browser on 25-26 November 2026 (doc_id=138612), the Chișinău order read from the scan on chisinau.md in a browser on 26 November 2026
unsupported: where no rate is given, Chișinău's 0,185 % for 2025 is applied, another municipality's rate is an input (localRates.propertyTax)
farm land with buildings (0,1 % in Chișinău) and non-residential property (0,3 %) are not distinguished from residential property
Chișinău's exemption of part of the value for some groups of owners was not read
the council's increase of up to 300 % for neglected buildings and unworked land (art. 280 alin. (1¹)) is not modelled
local_rate: the municipality's rate is an input (localRates.propertyTax), default: Chișinău 2025, 0,185 %
